title: perf(ci): consume batch proof recordings, one composed closure recording, and a CI ratchet
body:
The composed-proof job reddened on an ephemeral artifact the proof driver
itself created: the bare lane ran beside a default-config coverage tracer,
because the script's `export COVERAGE_PROCESS_START=` -- written to mean
"off" -- is a start request to coverage 7.13.1, whose `process_startup()`
tests `is not None`, not truthiness. The tracer wrote `.coverage` into the
checkout at interpreter shutdown, the recorder's strace union folded that
openat into the bare record, and composed-compare reddened on
`bare only: ['.coverage']` while the line sets stayed byte-identical over
76 files -- the behaviour claim held; the file-set claim measured a tracer
the proof had installed itself, not the closures lane it exists to mirror.
Fix layer chosen: the proof harness's environment (option a -- no arm runs
coverage machinery it does not ask for), not a compare-side normalization:
the bare lane must be the closures lane, and the compare stays byte-exact
so nothing is blinded at the site it watches. The same empty-prefix idiom
in coverage_tree.sh's per-script combine step is fixed alike.

## Head

`fa6ca7c577036255b8fb4df8597ce9dd1153967f` merges main `2750ed4` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`58757aa8d37da997d847d3ce9f7919e685a7bde2` merges main `4878463` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`835483a5a0132c99bc1fb098c5cfc3202874ab1c` is the orchestrator's recarry of main into the previous head. It is not a clean merge of the live head and main (parent 1 and parent 2 do not merge cleanly; a resolution goes through prepr), so prepr checked this head.

`135be7b84e791e5591548562340e03a430003597` is the orchestrator's recarry of main into the previous head. It is not a clean merge of the live head and main (HEAD has 1 parent(s), not a 2-parent merge), so prepr checked this head.

`135be7b84` on `fix/r9-ci-consolidation-ratchet-proof`, branched off
`082654d7e` (the #2132 head the red run measured). Everything below was
measured at that head, 2026-10-12.

## Mutation proof

Two mutants, each with everything else at the head and restored after.

1. A genuinely-read extra file planted through the real recorder (the
   compare's teeth -- the proof must still refuse a real inequality). A
   scratch script recorded bare with one extra program file opened during
   the run, against an equal composed recording:

       NC_EXTRA_READ=custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json \
         env -u COVERAGE_PROCESS_START python tests/closure.py record \
         tests/nc_probe.py --out-dir <scratch>/bare-extra
       python tests/closure.py composed-compare \
         --composed-dir <scratch>/composed --bare-dir <scratch>/bare-extra

   output, rc 1:

       composed-compare: tests/nc_probe.py files differs
         bare only: ['custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json']
         composed only: []
       composed-compare: 1 inequality; remove the script from
         tests/composed_closures.json until it is proven

   the same one-file bare-only shape as the CI red: the fixed pipeline
   refuses a real read-set difference exactly as it refused `.coverage`.

2. The fix's own line deleted: `export COVERAGE_PROCESS_START=` restored
   (the pre-fix script, HEAD~1's copy) and the whole proof driver run on
   the same scratch script:

   - mutant: `.coverage` (53280 bytes) left in the checkout root;
   - fixed head: no `.coverage` in the checkout (`ls .coverage` fails).
   - the trap that hid it: under the mutant environment the bare record's
     `how` field still reads `audithook+sys.modules` -- closure.py tests
     `os.environ.get("COVERAGE_PROCESS_START")` for truthiness, coverage
     7.13.1 tests `is not None`; the two readers disagree about the empty
     string, and only coverage's reading writes files.

## Null control

The unmodified fixed pipeline, end to end, on a scratch fast script
(`tests/nc_probe.py`, untracked; `tests/composed_closures.json` pointed at
it temporarily; both restored, `git status --short` clean after):

    PYTHON=<scratch-venv> bash tools/coverage/composed_proof.sh

output, rc 0:

    === proving tests/nc_probe.py ===
    rc: bare=0 composed=0 traced=0
    composed-compare: 1 script(s) byte-identical, files and inert_reads both
    composed-proof: tests/nc_probe.py: line sets byte-identical over 76 file(s)
    composed-proof: every allow-listed script proven at this head

with no `.coverage` in the checkout afterwards. The equal-case control
(two bare recordings of the same script) compares byte-identical, rc 0.
`python tests/closure.py selftest` at the head: `ALL 93 closure shrink
pins PASSED`, including the composed-compare pins (equal passes; a
composed read set missing a file reddens; a bare recording with no
composed one reddens). Stated plainly: the step from "`.coverage` written
at child exit" to "`.coverage` in the bare record" is the recorder's
strace union, which exists only on CI's Linux recorder -- macOS has no
strace, so the local run cannot reproduce the red itself; the fold is
evidenced by the CI log quoted below, and the artifact's creation under
the mutant and its absence under the fix are demonstrated locally at the
exact invocation shape above.

## Figures

- The failing check (composed-proof, job 114682964269, run 38206392171,
  head 082654d7e), quoted from the job log:

      rc: bare=0 composed=0 traced=0
      composed-compare: tests/boost_drift_replay.py files differs
        bare only: ['.coverage']
        composed only: []
      composed-compare: 1 inequality; remove the script from
        /home/runner/work/heatpump_optimizer/heatpump_optimizer/tests/composed_closures.json
        until it is proven
      composed-proof: tests/boost_drift_replay.py: line sets byte-identical
        over 76 file(s)

- The cause, one second, measured at both ends of the semantic change:

      COVERAGE_PROCESS_START= python -c \
        "import coverage; c = coverage.process_startup(); \
         print(c, c.config.data_file if c else None)"

  under coverage 7.13.1 (the pin in tests/requirements-coverage.txt):
  a started Coverage with `data_file` `.coverage` (relative), and a
  `.coverage` file of 53280 bytes appeared in the cwd. The same command
  under coverage 7.6.1 printed `None` and wrote nothing: 7.6.1's
  `process_startup` tested `if not cps` (truthiness), 7.13.1 tests
  `elif cps is not None` (with COVERAGE_PROCESS_CONFIG). The empty export
  was "off" when the idiom was written and is a start request under the
  pin -- both readings pasted from `inspect.getsource(coverage.process_startup)`
  at each version.
- The idiom is gone from the tree:

      git grep -nE 'COVERAGE_PROCESS_START=( |$)' -- tools/

  returns only the comment lines that document the trap; every executable
  use is `COVERAGE_PROCESS_START="<rcfile>"` (assignment to a real path),
  `env -u COVERAGE_PROCESS_START`, or `unset COVERAGE_PROCESS_START`.
- The gate at this head:

      python tests/closure.py select --diff 082654d7ee60abc99d7520949e97a2f8ed37b674

  `MODE: SCOPED -- 1 script(s) run`: `tests/entities.py`; run at the head:
  `ALL 2260 ENTITY CHECKS PASSED`.
- `python tests/closure.py selftest` -> `ALL 93 closure shrink pins PASSED`.
- `python tests/structure.py` -> `STRUCTURE RATCHET PASSED`.
- `python tools/audit/seat/tmp_paths.py --check tools/coverage/composed_proof.sh
  tools/coverage/coverage_tree.sh` -> `0 refused, 0 stale allow entries`.
- `bash -n` on both changed scripts: clean.

## Red checks

- `composed-proof` (job 114682964269, ~1h53m on the failing run). The red
  was the proof catching its own environment leak, not a program-read
  difference. Cause: the proof script's `export COVERAGE_PROCESS_START=`.
  Process state: (d) the process was sound and its preconditions changed
  underneath it -- the empty-export idiom correctly meant "off" under the
  coverage the composition machinery was developed against (7.6.1 measured
  above) and became a start request under the pinned 7.13.1, with no
  failure nearer than the 2h lane. Cheaper detector: the one-second probe
  in Figures (`COVERAGE_PROCESS_START= python -c "import coverage;
  coverage.process_startup()"` and look for a tracer), runnable locally
  before any push that touches COVERAGE_PROCESS_START handling; standing
  cost about one second against a ~2h lane per occurrence. Countermeasure:
  not built in this fix -- the idiom no longer occurs in the tree (grep
  above), both former sites carry the trap as in-tree comments naming the
  two readers' disagreement, and the countermeasure decision (a grep pin
  over the composition scripts was the candidate) belongs to the
  root-cause seat beside this fix, which defect-root-cause.md keeps
  procedurally outside the fixer's hands.
- `budget-raise-gate` is red at this head, and not this fix's: the branch
  (three-dot from origin/main) carries #2132's initial
  `tests/ci_budgets.json` record -- 22 owner-gated leaves the base's gate
  reads as raises until tvofi approves at the head. This commit touches
  no `*_budgets.json` (its diff names two scripts under `tools/coverage/`
  only, `git diff HEAD~1 --stat` above); the answer -- the initial record
  of the ratchet tvofi asked for, no existing budget value moved, one
  owner review of the head owed -- is #2132's own `## Red checks`, which
  names it with the recorded refusal of a cheaper detector (a new-file
  first-record arm would let an owner-blind first recording of one-way
  caps through, which is what the gate exists to prevent); standing cost
  one owner review of the head.
- `fast (3.14)` went red at the branch's earlier head `6f3c2713c9` (run
  38189399334) on the CI ratchet's null control: the committed
  `archscore.coord_footprint` 2586 was recorded at main `a74520020` and
  main's own merges (#2070/#2114/#2130) grew the live vector to 2587, so
  the recarry carried growth this branch never authored (its
  three-dot `custom_components` diff is empty). Answered at `082654d7e`
  by #2132's re-record 2586 -> 2587, reason in the budget file's
  `reason` field and the head commit's message; the null control IS the
  cheaper detector and its standing cost is one entities.py pass, already
  paid. At the merge head `835483a5a` (main's #2129 inert-reads and a1
  arms unioned into this branch) `python tests/entities.py` (which drives
  it) prints `ALL 2271 ENTITY CHECKS PASSED` -- 2260 at `135be7b84` plus
  the checks the union with #2129's side added (inert-read probes, the a1
  dispatch-arm job pins), all green on first run at the merged tree;
  `python tests/closure.py selftest` -> `ALL 93 closure shrink pins
  PASSED` there too.
- `instrument-self-tests` went red at the branch's earlier heads
  (`476dac6e0`, `f7d1bcf86`, `648f22d7a`): this PR added
  `tests/ci_budgets.json` as a seventh tracked `*_budgets.json` without
  teaching `budget_raise_gate.py`'s SCHEMA its leaves; the repair landed
  at `ba7455ea5` and the self-test reads `219 checks, 0 failed` since.
  The cheaper detector is the self-test's own tracked-file loop, one pass
  per push, already paid; green at this head. Both of these reds are
  #2132's history between origin/main and this head, answered here
  because the red-history obligation covers every head of the range.

## Forward-carry

none

## Friction

none
